answers.answer: Primary source, APH 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (filed 2026-07-31, accn 0001104659-26-089194). The Communications Solutions segment is approximately 62% of Q2-2026 net sales (60% for the first six months) and its net sales rose 85% in USD, 84% in constant currency and 42% ORGANICALLY versus Q2-2025; the filing attributes the increase to 'outsized organic growth in the IT datacom market, with particular strength in AI-related' demand. Separately, APH closed the acquisition of CommScope's Connectivity and Cable Solutions business on 2026-01-09 (adds fiber-optic interconnect for IT datacom and communications networks), funded with Delayed Draw Term Loans ($1,534.1M drawn under each; the 364-day loan stood at $934.1M at 06-30 after a $600M repayment). NOT established: a stand-alone IT-datacom share of total net sales -- the sentences retrieved give the segment share (62%) and the segment growth, not the market split. Two facts follow: (1) the 'lowest AI torque per dollar in the cluster' premise for APH is contradicted by its own largest segment growing 42% organically on AI-related datacom demand; (2) APH now carries acquisition leverage and fiber content that the ladder did not model.
